proof_nl: Let x be any real number. By the definition of the fractional-part function frac, its value at x is x minus the greatest integer less than or equal to x, namely floor(x). Therefore frac(x) = x - floor(x), as claimed.
solver_summary: The lemma is exactly the defining identity of the fractional-part function: for every real x, frac(x) is x - floor(x).
